| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Output** `output` | Regions | Regions, Boundaries over the image, Mean color of each region | The regions as a label map, drawn over the image and listed in the Features panel. Or the boundaries in yellow over the image, or each region filled with its mean color. |
| **Color weight** `ratio` | 1 | 0 to 1 | How much color counts against position, from 0 to 1. scikit-image uses 1. |
| **Kernel size** `kernelSize` | 5 | 1 to 20 | The width of the Gaussian that estimates the density. scikit-image uses 5. |
| **Longest link** `maxDist` | 10 | 1 to 100 | Links longer than this, in color and position, are cut. scikit-image uses 10. |
| **Smoothing** `sigma` | 0 | 0 to 5 px | The sigma of a Gaussian blur first. scikit-image uses 0, no blur. |
